input.overview: On a restored Magic Girl running myPinballs software v1.0, complete the four lower lanes to light locks, lock one ball on each ramp, and take the third lock at the Kings Chamber / spirit ring to start three-ball Multiball. The longer route completes five color-coded Master challenges at the Magic Shoppe before Excalibur.
input.simpleOverview: On a restored software-v1.0 machine, complete the four lower lanes to light locks. Lock one ball on each ramp, then take the third lock at the Kings Chamber / spirit ring to start three-ball Multiball.
input.summary: Complete the four inlane and outlane letters to light locks, then lock one ball on each ramp. Take the third lock at the Kings Chamber / spirit ring to start three-ball Multiball; follow the rear-box targets and left loop for its ordered Jackpots.

quickInfo.name: Newton two-ball
quickInfo.summary: Hit the captive ball five times, then shoot the Kings Chamber.

steps.text: Complete the four lower inlane and outlane letters to light the ball locks.
Lock one ball on the left ramp and one on the right ramp.
Send the third ball to the Kings Chamber / spirit ring to start three-ball Multiball; if the installed software explicitly directs the early third lock back to a ramp, follow that lit insert.
During Multiball, hit the rear Kings Chamber box targets to light the left-loop award, then collect Bronze, Copper, Silver, Gold, and Platinum in order.

alternatives.title: Newton two-ball Multiball
alternatives.when: Use this route when the captive ball is safer than the two-ramp lock sequence.

steps.text: Hit the Newton captive ball five times to qualify the feature.
Shoot the Kings Chamber to start two-ball Multiball, then return to the captive ball for its Jackpots.
When a Master challenge is lit, shoot the Magic Shoppe scoop and select the available challenge.
Complete Elements, Potions, Lightning, Optics, and Magnetism by following their matching colored shots and display prompts.
After all five Master challenges are complete, return to the lit Magic Shoppe to start Excalibur; the restored rules define it as an adjustable six-ball finale.

machineSetup: Confirm that the machine runs myPinballs software v1.0 with the rule document identified as revision 1.8 or a compatible later restoration release.

Verify that both ramp locks, their gates, the Kings Chamber / spirit ring, auto-launcher, Newton captive ball, rear box targets, left loop, and Magic Shoppe scoop work. Original as-shipped machines may not have functional hardware for this route.

cautions.issue: The originally shipped commercial machines were incomplete and may not support these rules or physical locks.
cautions.response: Confirm compatible myPinballs software and restoration hardware; otherwise treat the display and working hardware as authoritative.

cautions.issue: Software v1.0 with revision 1.8 differs from the unfinished original shipment.
cautions.response: Check the installed version before play and keep altered values or later restoration changes display-led.
